name: Ichimoku Tenkan/Kijun cross above the cloud
hypothesis: A conversion/base-line cross on the cloud's trend side, with price above where it was 26 bars ago, aligns three horizons of trend.

definition.name: Ichimoku Tenkan/Kijun cross above the cloud
